items: Metrics like NPS, sales and star ratings report problems after the damage is done, while predictive CX watches earlier signals so you can step in before a store's numbers drop.
Watch review sentiment trends, shifts in common complaints or keywords, sudden drops in survey satisfaction, and slower response times that may point to staffing gaps.
When a location starts slipping, fast local action such as adjusted staffing and shift coaching can resolve the issue before reviews turn visibly negative.
You can start without an analytics team by connecting review sites, survey tools, case management and operational data, so the system learns what normal looks like for each store.
